title: The medal
summary: You lose your first medal somewhere at the training ground and you can't tell anyone, because it's daft. The groundsman notices you looking. A season on, something turns up in the mower.

ends.title: In the mower
ends.text: You lost your first medal and the groundsman found it in the mower bag a season later. He'd polished it.

ends.title: Still out there
ends.text: Your first medal is somewhere at the training ground. You still look down sometimes, walking across pitch two.

event.title: Gone
event.speaker: groundsman
setup: Your first medal. You had it in your tracksuit pocket to show your mum, and now it's gone. Somewhere between the car park and pitch two. {groundsman.name} sees you walking very slowly, looking at the grass.

say: "Lost a contact lens, have you? You don't wear contact lenses."

truth.text: He doesn't laugh, which you'd expected. He walks the whole of pitch two with you in a line, like the police on the telly.

lie.text: "Car keys." He watches you walk past your car, which you've just unlocked.

beats.title: The mower bag

event.title: The mower bag
event.speaker: groundsman
setup: A season on. {groundsman.short} is waiting by your car with his hand closed. "Emptying the old mower bag. Thought I'd have a look first. Thought I might."

outcomes.text: Your first medal, ribbon gone, polished till it shines. "Took me an evening," he says. "Don't lose it again."
Your medal. "Car keys, was it?" he says. He's polished it anyway.
It's a ring pull and a two pence piece. "Worth a look," he says.
"Very funny." He drops the medal in your hand, polished, and walks off.
"Might be." He puts his hand back in his pocket and goes. You never find out what it was.

beats.hint: A season on, the groundsman's found something
